narrative.intro: GDC Middle East has $225M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. GDC Middle East received 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $112M. Obligations fell 34.6% year over year. Annual obligations show a rise beginning in FY24: FY24 obligations were $414M, FY25 obligations were $343M, and FY26 obligations are $225M to date. The FY2026 total is a fiscal year to date figure and represents contract obligations rather than total contract values. The firm has no recorded obligations in FY21, FY22, or FY23 in the provided figures. This profile reflects partial current-year totals and counts obligations only, with award-value exceptions noted separately in award tables that are not reproduced here.
